summaries.name: Ride with GPS
summaries.summary: Ride with GPS is a route planning website and app (web, iOS, Android) that allows creating and customizing bike routes, finding bike-friendly roads, and getting turn-by-turn directions.

summaries.name: MapMyRide
summaries.summary: MapMyRide is an app (web, iOS, Android) providing route planning, GPS tracking, and performance analysis, with a large community-driven route database.

summaries.name: Strava
summaries.summary: Strava is a social network for cyclists (web, iOS, Android) offering route planning, GPS tracking, and performance analysis; users can browse popular routes, create their own, and compete with friends.

summaries.name: Google Maps
summaries.summary: Google Maps (web, iOS, Android), while not cycling-specific, can find bike-friendly roads using its "Bicycling" mode, which gives routes that avoid highways and prefer bike paths and lanes.

summaries.name: Gatorade
summaries.summary: Gatorade is a sports drink containing electrolytes (sodium, potassium, calcium) recommended to help replace those lost through sweat during long or intense bike rides.

summaries.name: Nuun
summaries.summary: Nuun is a sports drink containing electrolytes (sodium, potassium, calcium) recommended to help replace those lost through sweat during long or intense bike rides.
